title: Noon Scrub + Afternoon Push — Samir Banerjee
content:
Noon scrub notes — quick, messy. Goal: 12–3pm push to convert 3 mid-funnel into demos or clear next steps. Focus: velocity > perfection.

Top metrics for today (quick):
- Daily dials target: 60 (AM: 28, need 32 more)
- Connects target: 15 (AM: 6, need 9 more)
- Demo commitments target: 3 (AM: 0, aim 3 in afternoon)

Timebox plan:
- 12:00–12:30: quick lunch + review notes
- 12:30–13:30: outbound call block (list A)
- 13:30–14:00: follow-up emails + LinkedIn touches
- 14:00–14:45: call block (list B)
- 14:45–15:00: wrap, update CRM, queue follow-ups

Priority call list (A = hottest; try to land demo or clear next step)
1) CatalystHealth — contact: Priya Suresh (Director of AI Ops) — stage: engaged (cold email -> demo interest) — last touch: 2026-09-10 (email) — ask: quick 20-min exploratory demo; risk: security questions, needs private deployment info — script snippets: "We can show a hosted demo first, then walk through private options — typical timeline for similar customers is 3–6 weeks for pilot." — notes: mention SLA/Dedicated capacity.

2) NimblyRetail — contact: Marcus Reed (Head of Platform) — stage: discovery — last touch: 2026-09-01 (voicemail) — ask: schedule architect intro (30m) to evaluate throughput needs — friction: quantization / latency concerns — script: lead with performance benchmarks (p50 p99) and batching options.

3) Acreborne LegalTech — contact: Sofia Kim (CTO) — stage: warm lead (referral from Partner) — last touch: 2026-09-12 (intro call, not technical) — ask: follow-up technical call w/ SRE (schedule) — note: high compliance need -> mention KMS/HSM + audit logs.

Secondary list (B) — aim for follow-ups or quick connects
- 4) OmniPay — contact: Dan Wu — left VM yesterday; send calendar with 3 slots.
- 5) TerraFleet — contact: Hannah Cole (Ops) — interested in embeddings trial — action: push trial instructions + quickest ROI use-case.
- 6) BlueNest Media — contact: Raj Patel — follow-up on content generation pilot; need cost estimate for 10k tokens/day.

Quick dispositions (for CRM):
- If prospect asks for pricing immediately -> push to demo, give ARR-band ranges only (no line item).
- If asks about private/on-prem -> set up intro with Solutions Eng (Lena) — label as P1.

Snippets for cold-to-warm scripts (short):
- If they ask about model options: "We host curated open models and provide dedicated variants — if you want lowest latency, our Dedicated pools give predictable p99s and autoscaling."
- If they push on cost: "We help teams trade off quantization and batching to hit cost goals — happy to run a quick simulation during a technical call."

Email follow-up template (quick, one-paragraph)
- Subject: Quick follow-up + 3 slots
- Body: Hi <Name>,
  Thanks for the time earlier — want to move to a short technical discussion to map latency/throughput constraints and a quick pilot plan. I have 3 slots: Tue 9:30, Wed 11:00, Thu 2:00 PT. Which works?
  — Samir

LinkedIn touch (short):
- Note: saw your post about scaling inference — we helped a payments company cut per-token cost by ~40% with batching + prefix caching; happy to share details on a 15-min call.

Realtime notes to self (scattered):
- mention Redwood Optimize suggestions (quant profiles) when cost is front-and-center.
- pull p99 numbers from playbook (console -> observability -> per-model) before call w/ NimblyRetail.
- for CatalystHealth, prepare high-level slide: Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private (one slide).

Follow-up actions right after each connect (checkboxes):
- [ ] Update CRM disposition + notes (no half-measures).
- [ ] Send calendar invite w/ agenda (3 bullets).
- [ ] Add to trial queue if agreed (tag as trial-30d).
- [ ] Notify Solutions Eng for any P1 private-deploy asks.

Pipeline nudges (things to test this week):
- Try a 4–1 cold call cadence (4 calls, 1 email) for the fintech cluster.
- Use short ROI-focused subject lines for follow-ups: "Pilot plan: 10–20% infra savings"

Bad call outcomes (common) — quick rebuttals to move on:
- "We already have a provider" -> "Totally — curious where you're seeing limits (cost, latency, reliability)? Even if you're happy, quick bench against your real throughput can be useful."
- "Too early" -> "No problem — could we book a 15-min check-in in 6 weeks?"

End-of-day wrap (reminder):
- Update JIRA card JIRA-8812 with any demo notes.
- Put CatalystHealth as top follow-up for next morning (email + 2 PM try).
- Daily reflection: what worked? quick list in CRM notes.

Random brain-dump (for later):
- Idea: one-pager comparing Dedicated vs Hosted with quick decision matrix (target: PD team + pre-sales).
- Ask SEs if we can shorten pilot onboarding checklist (remove extra checklist items that block legal).

-- end --

(WIP. messy, forgiving. meant for quick glance not polished doc.)
